newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil shrs lower on Telebras selling.
newsitem.headline: Brazil shrs lower on Telebras selling.

text.p: Brazilian shares pared early heavy losses and were 1.27 percent lower after benchmark Telebras preferred dived then recovered to trade only moderately lower on options settlement, brokers said.
The Bovespa index of the 47 most active stocks was down at 11,191 points at 1106 local/1406 GMT. Total market turnover was a moderate 259.3 million reais ($239 million).
Telebras preferred was off 0.73 percent at 136 reais after sliding over four percent earlier, they said.
"Trade is very volatile today as players are adjusting their positions because of the options settlement," a senior trader said.
Analysts said shares opened slightly ahead, but then sank over three percent before trimming losses mid-morning, helped by a good start on Wall Street.

Other key blue chips also traded lower. Federal power holding Eletrobras preferred was off 2.75 percent at 530.01 reais. State-run oil firm Petrobras preferred fell 2.33 percent to 294 reais. Preferred CVRD, the recently privatized mining giant, was flat at 25.40 reais.
